items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Each Done-when item from brief E1a is tested: round trip, refusals, secret per field, two-process add, worktree to main store, doc row.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Plain messages, exit codes 2/3/4, lock timeout 15s, corrupt lines surfaced.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Secret check on every text field incl. command and link fields; only validated fields persisted; control characters refused.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 39 tests incl. real git worktree and real processes; collision retry and lock timeout pinned.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Fold is linear over a small local log; lock held for one read plus one append.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Planned split followed; every file under 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer reminder_cli to file to consumer read_folded probed in the round-trip and worktree tests; contains_secret promotion covered by existing redact tests.
